note: Exact published package versions the tsc oracle compiles against. The Solid runtime pins match the repository audits: `v1` matches pkg/contracts/bundled/solid-v1/solid-js.json's `package.version`, `v2` matches pkg/contracts/bundled/runtime-lock.json. The v1 project also installs the exact @solidjs/signals helper used to exercise an unknown external-package contract while Solid 1.9.14 still selects the dialect. A newer release must be reviewed, never silently substituted -- the oracle verifies every installed version against `expect` and refuses to run on a mismatch.
